recommendations.name: MARUTI SUZUKI INDIA LTD.
recommendations.thesis: Maruti Suzuki sells affordable cars to India’s mass market. Its massive capex expansion will build new plants and launch electric models, positioning it to capture demand after GST reforms.

exit_conditions.condition: Maruti Suzuki reduces its planned ₹77,500 crore capex by more than 20%.

recommendations.name: JD.com, Inc.
recommendations.thesis: JD.com runs China’s largest e‑commerce platform and owns a nationwide delivery network. It is shifting capital into cloud and fintech services to raise margins beyond retail. The delivery network gives it a cost advantage that can support the new high‑margin businesses.

themes.name: Chinese NEVs Expand Globally
themes.why_it_matters: The investor’s focus on carmakers means exposure to rising EV competitors. Chinese NEVs’ global push could reshape market dynamics and create new growth opportunities over the next five years.

themes.name: Maruti Suzuki Massive Capex Expansion
themes.why_it_matters: A large capex plan signals strong growth prospects in India, a key emerging market for carmakers. Over a five‑year horizon, this could translate into higher earnings for investors willing to take on higher risk.

evidence.relevance: Maruti Suzuki announces ₹77,500 crore capex for expansion, R&D, and cleaner manufacturing.

themes.name: Automotive Cybersecurity Imperative
themes.why_it_matters: Digitalization in vehicles introduces new risk vectors. Investors in carmakers should monitor how firms invest in cybersecurity, as failures could erode brand value and profitability.

evidence.relevance: Auto industry must stay ahead of hackers, emphasizing cybersecurity needs.

themes.name: JD.com Capital Shift from Consumer Sectors
themes.why_it_matters: A move away from consumer spending could signal weakening demand in the sector the investor follows. Monitoring this trend helps gauge potential headwinds for consumer‑cyclical stocks.

evidence.relevance: JD.com shifts capital allocation away from traditional consumer sectors.
